evidence: Act A1459 is the only Act titled Pencegahan Jenayah (Pindaan dan Pemerluasan). It carries the year 2014 but received the Royal Assent on 25 October 2013, a month after this bill's first reading on 25 September 2013, and no other bill has that title. Parliament's listing gives no date for the bill's passing, so the year on the Act could not be checked against it automatically.

Act 776 is the only Act titled Majlis Keselamatan Negara. It carries the year 2016 and received the Royal Assent on 18 February 2016, after this bill's first reading on 1 December 2015, and no other bill has that title. Parliament's listing gives no date for the bill's passing, so the year on the Act could not be checked against it automatically.
